name: firecrawl
description: AI-powered web scraping skill using Firecrawl framework with natural language extraction, MCP integration, and LLM-ready output

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create new Firecrawl project with client setup, schema templates, and test fixtures

commands.name: scrape
commands.description: Extract content from a single URL with clean markdown/JSON output
examples: python firecrawl.py scrape https://shop.example.com --formats markdown --output page.md

commands.name: crawl
commands.description: Recursively crawl a website with configurable depth and limits

commands.name: agent
commands.description: Use AI agent for autonomous extraction via natural language prompt
examples: python firecrawl.py agent 'Find the founders of this company and their backgrounds'
python firecrawl.py agent 'List all products and their prices' --schema schemas/product.py

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search the web and extract full content from results
examples: python firecrawl.py search 'best web scraping tools 2024' --limit 10
python firecrawl.py search 'mechanical keyboard reviews' --output results.json

commands.name: map
commands.description: Discover all URLs on a domain with optional search filtering

commands.name: status
commands.description: Check Firecrawl installation status and API key configuration

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show help information with all commands and examples
